w22 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: tall relief in the dark thirds gives spires; refused

w13b at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: w12b with the fine colour map of MAIL 1422 item 3 (the picture's detail as colour on the code's tops). Reads as painted pillows; the storm gains its fibres. Line (i) 17.557
w12b at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: the same tops rounder and softer, less warp. Reads as a field of soft cloud pillows; storm rings and eye still wrong. Line (i) 17.275
w12 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: round tops as the surface itself (one dome to a cell, octaves riding), no balls. Dark thirds dark by shade for the first time; reads as rock. Line (i) 17.964
w11 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: packed dim balls in the dark field. Refused: nuggets strewn over wax. Line (i) 18.680

State for MAIL 1413, frame 3150, preview, draft: this state with three solve rounds (top left), main (top right), approved (bottom). Line (i) 7.873 against main 3.390 at the same tier: red. Bands green
State for MAIL 1413, frame 3200, preview, draft: this state (left) beside main (right). Storm rings read as contour lines with a pit for an eye; right third is blue cloth

w8 3150 preview draft, scaffold off: clusters smaller, sunk, none in the shear. Still silk with popcorn; line (i) 18.635
w7 3150 preview draft, scaffold off: low deck, threads along the flow, clusters with their own colour. Refused by me: white popcorn on dark silk, eye a black pit
